title: Analista de Docagem II
description:
A pessoa será responsável pelo planejamento e acompanhamento dos projetos de docagem , incluindo avaliação técnica, gestão de inventário, uso de tecnologias e relacionamento com clientes, embarcações e terceiros. Também apoiará na elaboração de relatórios, estimativas de custos e na identificação de melhorias contínuas nos processos .

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de docagem ;
  • Avaliar as especificações técnicas dos projetos de docagem ;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos de docagem , incluindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Desenvolver Comunicação e Relacionamento com clientes internos;
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre os projetos de docagem , incluindo análises de progresso e recomendações para melhorias futuras;
  • Realizar gestão de inventário de peças, materiais e equipamentos a serem utilizados durante os projetos de docagem ;
  • Desenvolver e manter procedimentos operacionais para garantir a consistência e a qualidade nos processos de docagem ;
  • Implementar e supervisionar o uso de tecnologias avançadas, como sistemas de controle e monitoramento e BI;
  • Acompanhar os serviços das empresas terceirizadas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos de docagem ;
  • Estabelecer comunicação com as embarcações que irão docar;
  • Participar na elaboração de estimativas de custos para projetos de docagem .

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia: Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval.
  • Experiência na área ou função similar.
  • Inglês intermediário - capacidade de ler e escrever.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos negócios e compreensão das operações na área offshore;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pacote Office, principalmente Word, Excel e Powerpoint;
  • Conhecimento em BI (mineração de dados, geração de relatórios, análise descritiva).
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Executivo(a) de Vendas – Remoto

EAD Marketing & Assessoria

Sobre a Empresa

A EAD Marketing & Assessoria é uma empresa especializada na comercialização de produtos de alto valor no mercado digital, atuando com estratégias estruturadas de vendas e relacionamento com clientes.

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuação remota, com foco na condução do processo comercial do início ao fechamento.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por gerenciar o relacionamento com leads e clientes, identificar oportunidades de negócio e apresentar soluções personalizadas de acordo com as necessidades de cada perfil.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais por vídeo chamada;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados ao longo do ciclo de vendas;
  • Gerenciar pipeline e registros no CRM;
  • Qualificar oportunidades e conduzir negociações;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e metas comerciais;
  • Contribuir para o crescimento sustentável da área de vendas.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas ou fechamento de contratos;
  • Vivência com metas comerciais e acompanhamento de indicadores;
  • Boa organização para gestão de pipeline e CRM;
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara e profissional;
  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações de forma estruturada.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado de marketing digital ou infoprodutos;
  • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de CRM;
  • Experiência com produtos de maior valor agregado.
Modelo de Trabalho
  • Atuação 100% remota
  • Remuneração fixa + variável por desempenho
  • Possibilidade de crescimento interno conforme resultados e evolução profissional

title: Consultor(a) SAP SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.

Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.

Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.

✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA FI SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA MM SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PM-PP SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA SD-CS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA CO SR

Sobre as oportunidades:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado.
  • Prazo: 12 meses renováveis.
  • Atividades: Atuação em projeto de conversão para SAP S/4HANA , conduzindo análise de impacto, adequação e estabilização de processos nos módulos FI, CO, MM, SD-CS, PS, PP e PM . Responsável por: Liderar diagnóstico de impactos da conversão (processos, dados e integrações); Garantir integração end-to-end entre áreas financeira, controladoria, suprimentos, vendas, projetos, manutenção e produção; Revisar e estabilizar processos ponta a ponta; Planejar e executar testes (unitários, integrados, UAT e regressão); Atuar em cutover e hypercare, assegurando consistência de saldos, estoques, custos e faturamento; Garantir compliance contábil/fiscal e integridade de dados mestres; Suportar estabilização pós-go-live, atuando na resolução de incidentes críticos e governança de correções.
  • Local: Atuação remota com solicitações de idas esporádicas sob demanda.
  • Despesas: Reembolsáveis.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA no módulo de atuação (FI, CO, MM, SD, PS, PM ou PP).
  • Participação em ao menos um projeto de conversão ECC → S/4HANA ou rollout.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos de S/4HANA no respectivo módulo (simplificações, mudanças de processos e dados).
  • Experiência com testes (unitário, integrado, UAT) e validação de consistência (saldos, estoques, custos ou documentos, conforme módulo).
  • Vivência em cutover e suporte pós-go-live (hypercare).
  • Familiaridade com Fiori e integrações com módulos correlatos.

Desejável:

  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

Vem ser #TimeSeidor

Acompanhe a Seidor nas redes sociais:

description:
Estágio em Pré-Vendas (SDR) — Área Comercial

Lajeado/RS | Presencial / Híbrido (mínimo 3 dias presenciais)

A Natural Talks está em busca de uma pessoa estagiária para atuar como SDR (Sales Development Representative) e apoiar o crescimento da nossa área comercial. Se você é comunicativo(a), curioso(a) e quer aprender na prática sobre vendas consultivas e geração de oportunidades, essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a Natural Talks

Somos uma empresa focada em soluções de comunicação e tecnologia que ajudam organizações a se conectarem melhor com seus públicos por meio de experiências conversacionais inteligentes.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa de leads (outbound)
  • Qualificar oportunidades de vendas
  • Fazer o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes (e-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e telefone)
  • Agendar reuniões para o time de vendas
  • Atualizar e organizar informações no CRM
  • Apoiar na melhoria contínua dos processos de pré-vendas
  • Colaborar com marketing e vendas para geração de pipeline

Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

  • Estar cursando ensino superior (Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Gestão Comercial ou áreas relacionadas)
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Organização e proatividade
  • Interesse em aprender sobre vendas B2B e tecnologia
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido com mínimo de 3 dias presenciais em Lajeado/RS

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia (mesmo que acadêmica) com vendas ou atendimento
  • Familiaridade com CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, etc.)
  • Conhecimento básico em LinkedIn para prospecção
  • Interesse por startups e tecnologia

O que oferecemos

  • Bolsa estágio compatível com o mercado
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento e efetivação
  • Ambiente de aprendizado acelerado
  • Contato direto com time comercial e liderança
  • Cultura colaborativa e orientada a resultados

Modelo de trabalho

  • Híbrido — mínimo de 3 dias presenciais em Lajeado/RS
  • Carga horária de estágio a combinar

Como se candidatar

Se você quer iniciar sua carreira em vendas consultivas e crescer junto com a Natural Talks, candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo.

title: Arquiteto .Net
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de microsserviços robustas, escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Aplicar os princípios de Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) para modelar sistemas complexos.
  • Definir a estratégia de containerização e orquestração de serviços, garantindo a portabilidade e a alta disponibilidade.
  • Garantir a observabilidade das soluções, implementando ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento, tracing e logging.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções com foco em Clean Architecture e na cultura de testes de software para assegurar a qualidade e a confiabilidade do código.
  • Explorar e propor novas tecnologias e abordagens para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência como Arquiteto de Software ou em papéis semelhantes, com forte background em tecnologias Microsoft (.NET Core).
  • Conhecimento em: containerização e orquestração de contêineres (Docker, OpenShift e etc.)
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Event-Driven Architecture (EDA).
  • Clean Architecture.
  • Microservices.
  • Testes de software (TDD, BDD, etc.).
  • Observabilidade (ex.: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência em ambientes de inovação, como prototipagem rápida, experimentação com novas ferramentas e integração de IA/ML é um diferencial.
  • Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Habilidades de comunicação excelentes, com capacidade de mentorar equipes e apresentar soluções técnicas.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net + Angular Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedor(a) .NET e Angular para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar soluções digitais escaláveis, atuando em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Vivência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções backend utilizando .NET (Core e Framework), atuando na construção, evolução e sustentação de aplicações;
  • Experiência consistente no desenvolvimento frontend com Angular, contribuindo para interfaces performáticas e bem estruturadas;
  • Experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, com uso recorrente de Oracle e MongoDB;
  • Atuação em integrações entre sistemas, utilizando SOAP e REST APIs, garantindo comunicação eficiente e confiável;
  • Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, com atuação em GCP ou AWS, apoiando deploys, escalabilidade e sustentação das aplicações;
  • Vivência com conteinerização e orquestração, utilizando Docker ou Kubernetes, em contextos de desenvolvimento e produção;
  • Experiência com mensageria e gestão de filas, atuando com comunicação assíncrona e desacoplamento de sistemas, utilizando ferramentas como RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS, Google Pub/Sub ou similares;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e adaptação, com facilidade para atuar em diferentes contextos, projetos e times.

Será um diferencial se você tiver também:

  • Experiência adicional com React.js e React Native, ampliando sua atuação no frontend;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como DataDog, New Relic, Grafana ou similares, apoiando análise de performance e confiabilidade das aplicações;

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida

Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo .

title: Analista de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.

Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.

Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.

Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais

CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;
  • Homologar processos dos sistemas junto aos usuários, prestando apoio técnico, orientando-os na sua operacionalização e validação;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
⚠️ Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.


Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote

Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.

Key Responsibilities

Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.

  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline

Required Technical Skills

  • Python (advanced)
  • Production ML model development and training
  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

title: Técnico Químico / Colorista
description:
Sobre a Empresa



A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional líder no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países e 80 anos de história no Brasil, nosso compromisso é oferecer as melhores soluções em tintas para as mais diversas finalidades, atendendo às necessidades de nossos clientes com qualidade e inovação.



Sobre o Papel



Estamos em busca de um Técnico Químico I cujas principais serão responsável por realizar o desenvolvimento, ajuste e controle de cores em tintas automotivas e industriais, com ênfase em sólidas (monocromáticas), perolizadas e metálicas. Atuará diretamente no laboratório de desenvolvimento, criando formulações, garantindo reprodutibilidade e suportando áreas como P&D, Qualidade e Produção. Local de atuação: Sumaré / São Paulo.



Responsabilidades



  • Desenvolver novas cores sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas conforme demandas de clientes, tendências de mercado ou projetos internos.
  • Ajustar tonalidade, flop, brilho e efeitos especiais utilizando pigmentos metálicos e perolizados.
  • Realizar correções de cor utilizando espectrofotômetro, software colorimétrico e cabine de luz.
  • Executar testes físico-químicos: viscosidade, brilho, aderência, resistência, densidade, entre outros.
  • Avaliar curvas de cor, diferença ΔE, metálicos e flop no espectrofotômetro.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e fichas de formulação.
  • Registrar ajustes, histórico de lotes e parâmetros críticos do processo.
  • Suportar o time de produção em ajustes de tonalidade em escala industrial.
  • Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Vendas em projetos especiais e atendimento ao cliente.



Qualificações


  • Conhecimentos Essenciais
  • Experiência comprovada em tintas sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas (automotivas, industriais ou repintura).
  • Domínio de espectrofotômetro e softwares colorimétricos (ex.: Datacolor, X-Rite).
  • Conhecimento em pigmentação, dispersão e comportamento de flake metálico e mica perolizada.
  • Leitura e interpretação de curvas de cor e parâmetros Lab*.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em laboratório de P&D.
  • Conhecimento em colorimetria avançada e ajustes complexos (high flop, alto brilho, efeitos especiais).


Formação Acadêmica


  • Técnico em Química (obrigatório).
  • Superior em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • CRQ ativo.



Experiência Mínima


2 a 5 anos em laboratório de tintas, preferencialmente com foco em cores especiais (metálicas e perolizadas).

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior/Especialista
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.

Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.

Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.

Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.

O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.

Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .

Location: Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.

Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelors ( or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .

If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office

Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.

The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: SQL Architect
description:
Job Title: Solution Architect / Technical Architect

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract

Key Responsibilities:

• We are seeking a seasoned Solution Architect / Technical Architect with 15+ years of IT experience, including 10+ years in public cloud offerings such as Microsoft Azure.

• Conduct AS-IS assessments of applications, design target state architectures, and obtain approvals from client architecture review boards.

• Drive cloud solutioning activities for large-scale Azure migrations and transformations.

• Design and build Azure Landing Zones, ensuring alignment with business, application, and infrastructure strategies.

• Provide Azure target architecture diagrams (HLD & LLD), BoM pricing, and licensing details.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

• Troubleshoot Azure and Windows environments, including processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory issues.

• Ensure projects meet stakeholder expectations, value-for-money considerations, and governance requirements.

Must Have Skills:

✔ Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS, Azure Migrate, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM)

✔ Architecture frameworks and solution design expertise

✔ Cloud migration and transformation experience (on-prem to public cloud)

✔ Azure Landing Zone design and implementation

✔ Strong troubleshooting skills in Azure & Windows environments

✔ Experience across multiple industry domains (banking, healthcare, insurance)

✔ Stakeholder management and documentation (HLD, LLD, approvals, governance)

Good to Have:

  • Certifications: AZ-305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ-104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator)
  • Secondary Skills: Infrastructure/data storage design, business continuity/DR solutions, identity/governance/monitoring solutions
  • Tools: Project management tools (ADO), knowledge of pricing/licensing models

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Backend Júnior

Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Construir e configurar dashboards seguindo as especificações de escopo;
  • Desenvolver consultas em banco de dados para alimentar os indicadores e gráficos dos painéis;
  • Realizar a validação técnica dos dados para garantir a integridade das informações apresentadas;
  • Elaborar documentações e textos de auxílio dentro dos painéis para orientar os usuários;
  • Realizar manutenções, correções e atualizações em dashboards já existentes;
  • Interagir com a equipe interna para alinhamento de demandas.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou cursando em áreas relacionadas a TI;
  • Conhecimento em linguagem SQL , com foco em DQL (capacidade de construir consultas com SELECT, JOINs, filtros e agrupamentos );
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com forte atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita para elaboração de documentações técnicas.

Será um diferencial!

  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia com o banco de dados PostgreSQL ;
  • Conhecimento básico de HTML;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente ou suporte técnico.

Por que #VemParaSyonet? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente!

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.

About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.

Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.

Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.

  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)

  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page .


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: IT Service Desk - Advanced English
description:
What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.

What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory

You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With

  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)

title: Auxiliar administrativo
description:
Auxiliar administrativo - Setor suporte técnico

Buscamos um profissional dedicado e organizado, para atuar no setor de suporte técnico, auxiliando nas rotinas de garantia e pós vendas.

* Realizar abertura, acompanhamento e encerramento de ordens de serviço;

* Registrar atendimentos técnicos, chamados, ocorrências e históricos de equipamentos;

* Apoiar o agendamento de atendimentos técnicos e deslocamentos de equipes;

* Organizar e controlar documentação técnica, relatórios e registros de manutenção;

* Apoiar a elaboração e conferência de relatórios técnicos e administrativos;

* Auxiliar no controle de peças, materiais e requisições da assistência técnica;

* Realizar interface administrativa entre clientes, técnicos de campo e setores internos;

* Apoiar o controle de contratos, prazos e garantias de equipamentos;

* Alimentar sistemas internos, planilhas e sistemas supervisórios quando aplicável;

* Apoiar rotinas administrativas da área de Assistência Técnica;

* Seguir procedimentos internos e orientações técnicas da empresa.

Requisitos:

Vivência anterior em assistência técnica/pós vendas;

Ensino médio completo;

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Desejável:

Ensino superior cursando.

Benefícios:

* Vale alimentação / Refeição;

* Vale combustível / VT;

* Plano de saúde estendido aos dependentes;

* Plano odontológico estendido aos dependentes;

* Auxílio educação.

Salário compatível com a função.

title: Partnership Manager for Integrated Platforms
description:
About Ant International (Antom) Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Through our Antom brand, we empower merchants worldwide to connect with over one billion consumers via seamless, secure, and innovative payment solutions. We are driven by the mission to use technology to provide inclusive financial services for individuals and small businesses globally.

The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of digital commerce? Ant International is looking for a strategic and high-impact Partnership for Integrated Platform to drive our expansion in Brazil. In this role, you will be a key driver of Antom’s growth, identifying prospecting opportunities and building the foundational partnerships that will scale our presence in one of the world’s most exciting fintech markets.

Key Responsibilities: What You’ll Do

  • Partnership Development & Sales Ownership: Work with various types of partners and platforms to actively identify, prospect, develop, and close key partnerships, leading and owning the full sales process.
  • Revenue & Growth: Consistently acquire new partners and drive revenue through efficient partnerships management, ensuring agreements are closed in a timely manner.
  • Market Intelligence & Networking: Stay informed on all relevant industry trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs, representing the company at various industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with partners and internal teams to manage expectations. Work closely with technical implementation and product teams to deliver solutions based on customer needs.
  • Onboarding & Client Experience: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure clients are on-boarded as quickly as possible while maintaining an excellent client experience.

Who You Are: Required Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of working inside TOP BR platforms or PSPs managing partnerships.
  • Networking Skills: Strong networking skills with an active network at C-level with international trade merchants within Brazil.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in delivering complex integrated sales and a history of being a relentless new business hunter with an exceptional track record of overachievement.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp strategic thinker who can think outside the box and adapt to fast-paced, high-growth, and complex sales cycles.
  • Sales Methodology: Knowledge of consultative/solution sales process and experience with the “Challenger” approach, including buyer profiling and risk assessment.
  • Relationship Management: Strong experience in developing and maintaining global, cultural, and long-term client relationships that sustain results.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency. Mandarin is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Finance.
  • An extensive network across Brazilian financial institutions and major retailers.

Why Join Ant International?

At Ant International, we thrive on innovation and global connectivity. You’ll be joining a team of builders who are redefining how the world pays and does business. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for the fintech revolution, we want to meet you.

Apply today and help us build a more inclusive financial future.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack – PHP/JavaScript Júnior
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Júnior Full Stack para atuar em projetos estratégicos de sistemas corporativos. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de soluções web, integrando tecnologias como PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript e PostgreSQL.

O candidato ideal possui experiência com sistemas de gestão administrativa, gestão de frotas, operação financeira bancária ou mercado de capitais. Conhecimentos adicionais em Visual Basic e Oracle serão considerados um diferencial.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web corporativas;
  • Integração com bancos de dados PostgreSQL;
  • Participação na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Suporte à operação e evolução de sistemas existentes;
  • Colaboração com equipes de negócio para levantamento de requisitos e implementação de soluções.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em PHP, HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em projetos complexos, propondo soluções técnicas e inovações.


Desejável:

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).

Will be a plus:

title: Líder de Ongoing
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder de Ongoing para conduzir a operação de pós-onboarding, garantindo retenção, engajamento e geração contínua de valor para clientes da área da saúde. Esse profissional liderará o time de Ongoing e atuará de forma integrada com Produto, Comercial, Suporte e Onboarding, assegurando a evolução dos processos e a excelência no relacionamento com os clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar o time de Ongoing, orientando prioridades, rotinas e boas práticas;
  • Garantir a execução consistente da estratégia de pós-onboarding, focada em adoção, engajamento e retenção;
  • Conduzir ritos de acompanhamento: alinhamentos semanais, health check de carteira, forecast e QBRs internos;
  • Monitorar indicadores como churn, retenção, engajamento, NPS e oportunidades de expansão;
  • Atuar diretamente em contas estratégicas ou sensíveis;
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua de processos, playbooks e documentação da área;
  • Conduzir feedbacks, desenvolvimento e treinamentos do time;
  • Atuar como ponte entre Ongoing, Produto, Comercial, Suporte e Onboarding;
  • Garantir uma comunicação clara, empática e consultiva com clientes do setor da saúde.

Requisitos:
